definition: Christopher Michael Bishop (born 7 April 1959) is a British computer scientist.
details: Wrote the foundational textbooks on statistical ML and deep learning, and leads Microsoft's global scientific AI initiatives. He is a Microsoft technical fellow and director of Microsoft Research AI4Science. He is also honorary professor of computer science at the University of Edinburgh, and a fellow of Darwin College, Cambridge. Bishop was a founding member of the UK AI Council, and in 2019 he was appointed to the prime minister's Council for Science and Technology.

explainer.lead: Christopher Bishop is a British computer scientist (born 1959). His work spans machine learning and informatics.
